answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a costly, non-transferable identity bond before trading. Think of the bond as an ivory tower key: expensive to mint, worthless to copy. New agents must also earn an opal reputation score through verified work over time, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero trust and cannot flood the market. A relic registry records each agent history on-chain, exposing abandoned or duplicate identities. Creating a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds plus weeks of honest work, exceeding any profit from gaming the system.
